'''Fush My Own WYS''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 16 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 WYS Fush LS 2003 MyOwnWYS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I’m trying to work this to become a decent WYS deck. I don’t have all the cards I need yet, but I believe I’m on the right track here. How would this work as a basis?

== Strategy ==

Is the activation high enough? I could probably put in Home One: DB. And Mos Espa DB would be in there for sure if I had it.

3 Lukes? One for beatdown, one for retriaval and one for BHBM. Talon Karrde will replace a raider as soon as I get him.

There’s not much retrieval in here. Tatooine Celebration will get a slot soon. And some Harvests along with Owen/Beru could probably be useful too. Kessel Runs would be a bonus, but I don’t depend on completing them.
